steps.message: Click the Double Line button to start drawing a planar ribbon-like surface.
pick a few points and then finish the Double Line tool by hitting Enter
Use a left-to-right selection window to select the entire shape you just created.
Click the Rotate button to start rotating the shape from the ground plane to a vertical plane.
Press T to place an axis helper at the cursor it will help specify the end angle for the rotation.
pick the folowing points: the rotation center where you placed the helper, on the rotation axis ( green or blue), on the initial angle and on the final angle(on the blue axis).
with the shape still selected click the Extrude Swipe button.
draw the trajectory of the sweep(on the ground) Finish the Extrude Swipe tool by hitting Enter
